text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyyyyyy☆
Ah ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Aha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!!!!!!!!
Daitaku Helios breaks into a laugh as she launches into an ultra-high-speed getaway. An ecstatic rush that feels ready to shatter any limit. But—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Guuuuuh...!!

Today—a ruthless wall of distance
stood towering before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It's no useeeeeee!!!!!!!!
From here on—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bestieee, baton touuuuch!!
I'll leave the rest to youuuu☆★☆★☆★!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heliooooos!!!!!!
I feel your viiibes loud and cleaaaar!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Leave the rest to meee!!!!
We're... best friends foreverrrrrr!!!!!

"Along with a declaration of eternal friendship, Mejiro Palmer
pulled off a historic, explosive runaway sprint. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer overtakes a fading
Daitaku Helios!
And now, she crosses the finish line in firrrst place!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
YEEEEEEEAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!
I feel freaking AMAZING!! The absolute BEEEEEST!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is me! This is Mejiro Palmer!!
I—I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'M RIGHT HEEEEERE!!!!
Fuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!!!!!!!

"—She lived, she learned, and she ran.
Mejiro Palmer radiated her brimming self
from head to toe, and then..."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Pal... mer... Pal... mer...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Paaal-meeeer! Paaal-meeeer!
Paaal-meeeer! Paaal-meeeer!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Paaal-meeeer!! Paaal-meeeer!!
Paaal-meeeer!! Paaal-meeeer!!
Paaal-meeeer!! Paaal-meeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
These... cheers are...
Aaaaah... Aaaaaaaaah...!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My name is...
Gwaaaaaaahhh!!
The long-awaited thunderous cheers. Shouts calling that name echo all across Nakayama Racecourse.

Everyone acknowledged her. Even if she was unconventional,
she was a magnificent front-runner: Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Maaan, you idiooooot!
You're trying to make me cry, aren't you! I love you sooo much!"

Surging emotions... Those words probably hold no meaning anymore.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Palmer. There was no way
I could've caught up to you today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, though our paths diverged, that sheer grit—
was undeniably Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, McQueen...
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I might not be the most typical Mejiro... but still... I am Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaahn, besties for life, yayyyâ
I'm so totally crying tears of joy right now~~,
so much loveee!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bestieee, I don't even know what's going on anymoreee!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Show me! And I'll show you too!
It's what I've wanted to see the most!
Plus, the Gal-leries are waiting~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What I wanted to see most of all...
Yeah, that's it.

—A stage crying out for freedom,
the place I wished to stand more than anywhere else, awaits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, BFF, watch me!
I'm gonna blow everyone away with something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy ayyyyyyy☆★☆!!
Mejiro Palmer burst into the winner's circle with incredible momentum.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Today's the day!
A legendary, totally hype,
mega festival party☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer conquers the Grand Prix!
She pulled it off! Woo-hoo, whooooo～!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Fuuuuuu～！！！！！！
There was no longer any hesitation. Just pure sharing of vibes and getting completely hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, thanks for the cheers~☆ Well, it's not like
us Mejiros act like total VIPs or anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Like, everyone's rolling around trembling,
going, 'Oh crap, she's completely untouchable~!'☆"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Still, even back when I was feeling down like that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, our vibes are connected, y'know?
Because I was who I was back then,
who I am right now... kinda makes sense?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, what you love is what matters, and you can't start anything without knowing that! So with that said—☆"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If it gets too painfully tough, run away~♪ Then fly away from there! And the most important thing is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally cracking up☆ Totally this!
At the end of all the laughs, there's my best bestie ever☆★☆★☆★☆!!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

It was a call to her past self.
And a call to someone who was locked away in their shell right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Now then, lastly, this...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Are you gonna say it~? You're saying it~! Say it, and theeeeeen!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(L-E-A-V-E Y-O-U-R M-A-R-K
ON THIS TRACKKKKK!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Umm... let me just say this one last thing, okay?
Something I've always wanted to shout out loud...
Mejiro Palmer gulped, taking a deep breath—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaayyyy☆
Grandmother, are you watchiiiiiing?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry for bein' a Mejiro full of funny vibes, 'kay?
But I went and nailed it too★
Ayyy ayyy, love yaaa~~♪"
(Silence...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaahhh, I totally blew it!
I'm so doneee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Run away like craaaazyyy!!!!!!!
To top it all off, Mejiro Palmer threw herself into an all-out dive that no one else could ever pull off—

She ran away faster than she ever had
in any race before.
